definitions.short: a descendant of the third degree, i.e. great grandchild
definitions.full: H8029. shillesh II. [ שִׁלֵּשׁ ] adjective pertaining to the third ; — only masculine plural as substantive שִׁלֵּשִׁים those of third Generation (grandsons); שׁ ׳בְּנֵי Gen 50:23 (E) sons of those of third Generation , i.e. great-grandsons (see Kö SK 1898, 533 ff. ); עַלשֿׁ ׳עַלבָּֿנִים וְעַלרִֿבֵּעִים Exod 20:5 (E; see [ רִבֵּעַ ]} = Deut 5:9 ; Num 14:18 , compare Exod 34:7 (both J).
